title: Card page flickers on live updates

message.text: A minion is on it. It will first measure which parts of the card page redraw when a live update arrives with nothing changed. Then it will make the page redraw only what actually changed, and test that a no-change update touches nothing. I'll report here when it's done.

Fixed. Every live update used to tear down and rebuild the card, the agents panel, the day index and the rail, even when nothing had changed. That was the flicker that goes back to how it was. It now redraws only what changed: an idle page made 61 changes in 8 seconds before and none now, and a real change touches one row instead of 23. Reload the page to pick it up.
